hooks.command:
in=$(cat)
t='(^|[^A-Za-z0-9_.-])([^/[:space:]"\\;|&<>]*\.test\.[^/[:space:]"\\;|&<>]*([^A-Za-z0-9_.-]|$)|[^/[:space:]"\\;|&<>]*\.spec\.[^/[:space:]"\\;|&<>]*([^A-Za-z0-9_.-]|$)|[^/[:space:]"\\;|&<>]*_test\.[^/[:space:]"\\;|&<>]*([^A-Za-z0-9_.-]|$)|test_[^/[:space:]"\\;|&<>]*\.py([^A-Za-z0-9_.-]|$)|test([^A-Za-z0-9_.-]|$)|tests([^A-Za-z0-9_.-]|$)|__tests__([^A-Za-z0-9_.-]|$)|spec([^A-Za-z0-9_.-]|$))'
f=$(printf '%s' "$in" | grep -Eo '"file_path"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"[^"]*"' | sed 's/^.*:[[:space:]]*"//; s/"$//')
u=$(printf '%s' "$in" | grep -Eo '\*\*\* (Update|Delete) File: [^\\"]+' | sed 's/^[^:]*: //')
hit=$(printf '%s\n%s\n' "$f" "$u" | while IFS= read -r p; do
  [ -n "$p" ] || continue
  printf '%s\n' "$p" | grep -Eq "$t" || continue
  if [ "${p#/}" = "$p" ]; then q=$PWD/$p; else q=$p; fi
  [ -e "$q" ] && { printf '%s\n' "$p"; break; }
done)
[ -z "$hit" ] && exit 0
m=$(printf 'Warning: %s is an existing test. Changing or removing an existing assertion needs the human'\''s approval; prefer adding a new test.' "$(printf '%s' "$hit" | tr -d '"\\')")
printf '{"systemMessage":"%s","hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"%s"}}\n' "$m" "$m"
exit 0
